conf.description: Windows DNS/DHCP dns-audit / windows-event: thin pass-through, parsing deferred to Elastic (elastic-integration).

conf.comment: windows-dns-dhcp / dns-audit / windows-event. Parsing is deliberately NOT implemented here: the Elastic integration is the parser downstream (Microsoft DNS Server Audit and Analytical logs integration (microsoft_dnsserver)). Re-implementing that parsing in Cribl would fight it and yield duplicate or conflicting fields, so this pipeline only identifies the event and tags event.dataset, then passes _raw through unmodified. Direct route (no cross-domain guard hop).

functions.description: record why this pipeline does not parse
tag the dataset before Elastic parses _raw
